blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We analyze how lexical ambiguity and underspecification affect language model training. We create artificial homonyms and artificial hypernyms as pseudowords and analyze the generative performance of language models as they are trained with increasing amounts of these ambiguous or underspecified pseudoword types. We further analyze whether the models disambiguate ambiguous or underspecified statements and provide a first mechanistic account of how ambiguity and disambiguation are represented internally. Our main results show that both ambiguity and underspecification increase model performance in ways that scale with their influence on the language’s type-token ratio. However, the accuracy of generating sequences containing ambiguous words or their synonyms decreases compared to other texts. We also show that internal representations of pseudowords reflect disambiguation of pseudo-homonyms, but underspecification of pseudo-hypernyms is maintained during the generative process.
blocks.zh: 我们分析词汇上的模糊和不够具体化如何影响语言模型培训。 我们创造了人为的同义词和人为的超义词作为伪词,并分析语言模型的基因表现,因为对这些模型的训练越来越多,这些模棱两可的或规格不足的假词类型。 我们进一步分析这些模型是否使模棱两可或不明确的说法脱节,并首先从机械角度说明内部如何表现模棱两可和模棱两可。 我们的主要结果显示,模糊和不够具体化都增加了模型的性能,其规模将影响语言的字型比。 然而,与其他文本相比,生成含有模棱两可的词组或其同义词的准确性有所下降. 我们还表明,对伪词的内部表示反映了对伪同义词的歧义,但在基因化过程中,对伪同义词的描述不够.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Ambiguity and related phenomena like underspecification are fundamental mechanisms of natural language. These phenomena have always been a main strand of research in theoretical linguistics Pinkal (1996) , language philosophy Khatchadourian (1962) , and computational linguistics Hobbs and Shieber (1987) ; Reyle (1993) . Ambiguity makes language more efficient, because it allows a smaller vocabulary to express a wider range of meanings ( Piantadosi et al., 2012 , cf. the optimality theory of language,) . The very same mechanism then also makes language more complex, because ambiguity or underspecification has to be resolved at the levels of words, sentences, and whole discourse segments.
blocks.zh: 模糊性和相关现象,如描述不足,是自然语言的基本机制. 这些现象一直是理论语言学Pinkal(1996年)、语言哲学Khatchadourian(1962年)和计算语言学Hobbs和Shieber(1987年);Reyle(1993年)的主要研究领域。 模糊使语言更有效率,因为它允许一个较小的词汇来表达更广泛的含义范围(Piantadosi等人,2012年,参考语言的最佳性理论,). 同样的机制也使语言更为复杂,因为含糊不清或具体化不够,必须在文字、句子和整个讨论部分各级加以解决。

blocks.en: While much of the research on computational language understanding focused on modeling and resolving different kinds of ambiguity, the advent of large language models (LLMs) changed this discussion rapidly. Transformer models Vaswani et al. (2017) , the most common architecture for modern LLMs, were specifically designed to handle ambiguity through the attention mechanism. This mechanism applies context to resolve token-level ambiguities and does so hierarchically across increasingly large units of text. The impressive performance of such models seems to confirm this promise: good performance in language understanding and generation requires effective ambiguity handling, and state-of-the-art LLMs seem to handle many such cases successfully. However, the question of whether and how LLMs model ambiguity successfully is still a subject of active research, and a consequential one. Recent studies Liu et al. (2023) ; Gehring and Roth (2025) have shown that LLMs actually do fall short in handling ambiguity, even if there is evidence that their parameters encode it Karamolegkou et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 虽然很多关于计算语言理解的研究都侧重于建模和解决不同种类的模糊性,但大型语言模型(LLMS)的出现迅速改变了这一讨论. 变形器模型Vaswani et al. (2017),现代LLMS最常用的架构,是专门为通过关注机制处理模糊性而设计的. 这一机制适用于解决象征层面的模糊性,并在日益庞大的文本单位之间进行分级。 这种模式令人印象深刻的性能似乎证实了这一前景:语言理解和生成方面的良好性能需要有效的模棱两可的处理,最先进的LLM似乎成功地处理了许多这类案件。 然而,LLMS模型是否和如何成功模糊的问题仍然是一个积极研究的主题,因此也是一个问题。 最近的研究刘等人(2023年);Gehring and Roth(2025年)表明,LLMs实际上在处理模棱两可方面做得不够,即使有证据表明它们的参数编码为Karamolegkou等人(2025年).

blocks.en: Understanding such mechanisms matters for several reasons: On one hand, it is relevant for mitigating and avoiding bias and discrimination in LLMs: if, e.g., a word is underspecified with respect to gender or nationality, a fair model needs to be capable of handling rare readings as well as frequent ones. On the other hand, ambiguity and underspecification make language more complex to process, while they also have the potential to compress it (as for human language processing). Given that LLMs require vast amounts of data and energy Strubell et al. (2019) , any additional complexity in language might make them less sustainable if that complexity also requires more powerful models. On the other hand, language compression while maintaining performance would be utterly desirable for sustainable models. Taken together, ambiguity and underspecification as potential contributors to the cost and societal impact of LLMs should be analyzed thoroughly, and models need to process them reliably and efficiently.
blocks.zh: 理解这些机制的重要性有几个原因: 一方面,它与减轻和避免法学硕士的偏见和歧视有关:例如,如果一个词在性别或国籍方面没有得到充分的描述,一个公平的模型必须能够处理罕见的读数和经常读数。 另一方面,模棱两可和不够具体化使得语言的处理更为复杂,同时它们也有可能进行压缩(如人类语言处理). 鉴于LLMS需要大量数据和能量Strubell等人(2019年),如果这种复杂性也需要更强大的模型,语言上的任何额外复杂性都可能使其更不可持续。 另一方面,在保持性能的同时进行语言压缩对于可持续的模式是完全可取的。 总体而言,应该彻底分析作为有限责任管理成本和社会影响潜在促成因素的模糊性和具体性不足,模型需要可靠和有效地处理。

blocks.en:
Our research aims to answer whether ambiguity and underspecification in language add complexity to language model training, and how this interacts with potential effects of language compression. To assess this, we train multiple small transformer models on corpora that we modify by increasing the number of artificial homonyms and hypernyms.
We then measure the models’ performance both overall and on the newly introduced ambiguous or underspecified words. We find that, in general, neither ambiguity nor underspecification harms the models’ performance. Our experiments also distinguish between setups in which we either delete synonyms of the newly introduced pseudowords or, as in natural language, maintain them, and show that the presence of synonyms harms performance, for generating both ambiguous words and their synonyms. We also give a first account showing localization of ambiguity in the model parameters, demonstrating an increased entropy in the models’ MLP layers when ambiguity or underspecification increases.
In a second step, we evaluate whether the models internally disambiguate artificial homonyms and whether they resolve the underspecification of artificial hypernyms. Our experiments show that while ambiguous terms are disambiguated in the respective context, abstract terms remain underspecified. Overall, our results can inform further research that looks at model complexity, but also on bias and model mistakes with disambiguation.
blocks.zh:
我们的研究旨在回答语言的模糊性和不够具体化是否增加了语言模型培训的复杂性,以及这如何与语言压缩的潜在效果相互作用. 为了评估这一点,我们通过增加人工同位素和超元素的数量,在蝎子上训练多个小型变压器模型进行修改.
然后,我们根据新提出的模棱两可或不明确的词语来衡量模型的总体业绩。 我们发现,一般而言,既无含糊不清,也无不足的描述,不利于模型的性能。 我们的实验还区分了我们要么删除新引入的假名的同义词,要么像在自然语言中一样,维持这些同义词,并表明同义词的存在会损害性能,因为产生模棱两可的词及其同义词. 我们还首先说明了模型参数中模糊度的本地化情况,并表明模型的MLP层在模糊度或不精确度增加时会增加。
第二步,我们评价这些模型是否在内部使人造同系物分解,以及它们是否解决了人造超系物的特性不足的问题。 我们的实验表明,尽管在相应背景下含糊不清的术语是模糊不清的,但抽象的术语仍然不够明确。 总体而言,我们的成果可以为进一步研究提供参考,这些研究审视模型的复杂性,但也审视偏颇和模范错误,以及模糊不清的问题。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows: • We analyze the influence of ambiguity on the performance of transformer models, distinguishing between ambiguous and underspecified words. We show that both greater ambiguity and greater abstraction increase model performance linearly with the decrease in type-token ratio. We also localize the increased ambiguity and underspecification in the models’ MLP layers. • We analyze the models’ specific capability of generating ambiguous or abstract words, and show that performance on generating ambiguous expressions decreases with more ambiguity, while abstract expressions can be generated more stably. • By activation analysis, we show that ambiguity and underspecification differ markedly in terms of resolution: While artificial homonyms are disambiguated in the model, artificial hypernyms retain their underspecified representations. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to relate ambiguity and abstraction, as sources of linguistic complexity, to language model performance, and to show how model training can benefit or suffer from them. We provide code and data for all our experiments. 1 1 1 https://github.com/mregneri/ambiguity_abstraction_llms/

blocks.en: 2 Background and Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 背景和有关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Ambiguity and Underspecification
blocks.zh: 2.1 含糊不清和规格不足

blocks.en: We analyze how ambiguity and underspecification affect language model performance. Concretely, we create corpora with artificial homonyms, train language models on them, and evaluate their performance as a function of the number of homonyms. We conduct analogous experiments using artificial hypernyms and compare the results. This setup draws on and contributes to several lines of research in linguistics and machine learning.
blocks.zh: 我们分析模棱两可和不够具体化如何影响语言模型的性能. 具体地说,我们用人工的同义词创建了corpora,在它们上训练语言模型,并评价它们的性能作为同义词数量的一个函数. 我们用人造高音进行类似的实验 比较结果 这种设置借鉴了语言学和机器学习的几条研究线,并为之做出了贡献.

blocks.en:
has been studied extensively, particularly at the word level. A first line of work investigates how models represent ambiguity internally. Beekhuizen et al. (2021) studied the differences between homonyms and polysemes in static word embeddings. We adapt some of their homonymy measures to filter and modify our corpora when introducing artificial homonyms. Haber and Poesio (2021) ; Haber and Poesio (2024) extended the analysis of homonyms and polysemes to LLMs, showing that their difference is predictable from the models’ embedding layers. Other work has found clear evidence that ambiguity is encoded in the models’ parameters Park and Kim (2025) , and models can also be tuned to handle ambiguity explicitly with alignment algorithms Kim et al. (2024) , supporting the hypothesis that they can encode ambiguity in principle.
A second line of work evaluates how models perform on ambiguity-related tasks. LLMs perform well on many tasks related to standard word sense disambiguation Sumanathilaka et al. (2024) , but still fall short in particularly challenging settings Gehring and Roth (2025) . Liu et al. (2023) provide a dataset with various types of ambiguity, and their experiments show how ambiguity affects entailment handling in LLMs, concluding that ambiguity is not properly modeled. Even when ambiguity is encoded in the parameters, models do not perform well when prompted to use it Karamolegkou et al. (2025) , and they often fall short in standard settings even after alignment tuning Kim et al. (2024) . This gap might be due to LLMs failing to recognize relevant ambiguity in user prompts ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
已经进行了广泛的研究,特别是在文字层面。 第一行的工作是调查模型如何代表内部的模糊性。 Beekhuizen等人(2021年)研究了静态词嵌入中的同义词和多义词的区别. 在引入人工同位素时,我们调整了一些它们的同位素措施来过滤和修改我们的蝎子. Haber and Poesio (2021) ; Haber and Poesio (2024) 将同义词和多聚物的分析扩展至LLMs,表明它们的差异从模型的嵌入层可以预测. 其他工作也发现了明确的证据,说明模型参数Park和Kim(2025年)中编码了模棱两可,模型也可以调谐,以明确用对齐算法处理模棱两可. Kim等人(2024年),支持他们原则上可以编码模棱两可的假设.
第二行工作评价模型如何执行与模糊有关的任务。 LLMS在很多与标准词感分化(Sumanathilaka et al.)(2024年)有关的任务上表现良好,但在格林和罗斯(2025年)特别具有挑战性的环境下仍然不足. 刘等. (2024)之后也经常出现故障. 这一差距可能是由于LLMs没有认识到用户提示中的相关模糊性(Zhang等人,2024年)。

Some studies focus on performance, e.g., showing the limits of LLMs’ conceptual knowledge Peng et al. (2022) and demonstrating that incorporating taxonomic relationships improves LLM reasoning Torres-Moreno and Hermosillo-Valadez (2026) . Models can also be prompted to produce taxonomic hierarchies, but the concept hierarchies encoded in earlier models like BERT seem to differ from human ones Dalvi et al. (2022) . As with ambiguity, taxonomic abstraction is recoverable to some degree from LLM parameters Regneri et al. (2024) . Beyond lexical abstraction, there are also studies on LLMs and scope underspecification Wildenburg et al. (2024) , which show that LLMs can detect underspecification and partially resolve it.
blocks.zh: 就我们而言,通过单词层次的超音速抽象化 将生物分类化 与模糊性相比,关于法学硕士的抽象性的研究相对较少。 一些研究侧重于性能,例如,显示LLMs的概念知识Peng等人(2022年)的局限性,并表明纳入分类关系可以改善LLM推理Torres-Moreno和Hermosillo-Valadez(2026年). 模型也可以被催生出分类等级,但早期模型中编码的概念等级,如BERT,似乎与人类的Dalvi等人(2022年)不同. 同模糊性一样,分类抽象从LLM参数Regneri等人(2024年)中在某种程度上可以恢复. 除了词典抽象外,还有关于LLMs和范围不具体化的Wildenburg等人(2024年)的研究,这些研究显示LLMs可以检测到不具体化并部分解决.

blocks.en:
have been used to assess varying linguistic phenomena, and we use them to study the effect of ambiguity and abstraction on LLMs. Pseudowords were originally invented to create datasets for word sense disambiguation Schütze (1998) . A pseudoword is an artificial term created by picking a word pair from a corpus, creating a new word similar to both original words, and then replacing occurrences of the original words with the new pseudoword.
While annotated datasets for word sense disambiguation exist by now, pseudowords are still used, e.g., to study language change Shoemark et al. (2019) and to show how word sense disambiguation is reflected in LLMs Karidi et al. (2021) .
Crucially for our setup, even unknown pseudowords are processable by LLMs de Varda et al. (2024) . Using arbitrary strings like "wd134x" would introduce out-of-distribution tokens bearing no subword-level similarity to any natural word, potentially creating unwanted confounds. Pseudowords avoid this problem because they are composed of familiar subword tokens.
blocks.zh:
我们用它们来研究模糊和抽象对法学硕士的影响。 Pseudowords最初被发明,用于创建词感分解的数据集Schütze(1998). 假名词是一种人工的术语,通过从一个实体中选取一个单词对,产生一个与两个原始词相似的新词,然后用新的伪名词取代原词的出现.
虽然现在已经存在文字感分解的注释数据集,但伪词仍然被使用,例如用于研究语言变化的Shoemark等人(2019年),以及显示文字感分解如何在LLMs Karidi等人(2021年)中得到反映.
对于我们的设置来说,关键是,连未知的假字都可以由LLMs de Varda等人(2024年)处理. 使用像"wd134x"这样的任意的字符串会引入分配外的符号,没有子词级与任何自然词的相似性,有可能产生不必要的混乱. Pseudowords避免了这个问题,因为它们是由熟悉的子词符号组成的.

blocks.en: 3 Dataset Creation
blocks.zh: 3 数据集创建

blocks.en: The following describes how we create our datasets for model training to measure the effects of ambiguity and underspecification.
blocks.zh: 以下介绍我们如何为模型培训创建数据集,以衡量模棱两可和规格不足的影响。

blocks.en: 3.1 Homonyms and Hypernyms
blocks.zh: 3.1 名和名

blocks.en:
We investigate word-level ambiguity and underspecification, concretely through homonyms and hypernyms. Homonyms are ambiguous words that have two disjoint readings ( bat , bank ), as opposed to polysemes, whose readings have semantic overlap to varying degrees (e.g., crane , paper ). A hypernym is a word whose meaning encompasses that of more specific words, its hyponyms ( animal (hypernym) – dog (hyponym)), and can have multiple hyponyms.
Comparing homonyms with hypernyms lets us contrast the effects of ambiguous words with semantically divergent readings against words with varying levels of underspecification. In vector space terms, this means we compare words that have close neighbors in very different regions of the space (cf. Sec. 3.4 ).
blocks.zh:
我们通过同义词和超义词 来调查字位模糊和描述不足的问题。 同义词是模糊的词,有两种脱节读法(bat, bank ),相对于多语种,其读法有不同程度的语义重叠(如鹤,纸). phypernym是一个词,其含义包括更具体的单词,它的hypernym(动物(hypernym) – 狗(hyponym)),可以有多个hypernym.

blocks.en: 3.2 Corpora
blocks.zh: 3.2 公司

blocks.en: To study the effects of ambiguity and underspecification, we chose to train small language models on narrow-domain language corpora. Our objectives were twofold: to isolate the effects of ambiguity and abstraction by starting with corpora that contain as little ambiguity as possible, and to keep the experiments computationally tractable.
blocks.zh: 为了研究模棱两可和描述不足的影响,我们选择了在狭域语言corpora上训练小语言模型. 我们的目标是双重的:从尽可能少含混不清的蝎子开始,孤立模糊和抽象的影响,并使实验能够计算。

blocks.en:
Since even highly domain-specific corpora typically retain some lexical ambiguity (e.g., scale in cooking still has readings related to measurement and fish skin), we cannot fully eliminate homonymy but aim to reduce it by restricting the domain.
We settled on two corpora that met two additional criteria: in their unmodified state, the difference between homonyms and monosemes was clearly measurable by semantic neighborhood distance (cf. Tab. 1 ), and both use common, everyday language rather than specialized jargon, which supports the generalizability of our findings. The two corpora are (1) RecipeNLG Bień et al. (2020) , containing cooking recipes (1.9 mio documents, 63k word types, 195 mio tokens), and (2) TinyStories Eldan and Li (2023) , containing short LLM-generated children’s stories in simple language (2.1 mio documents, 24k word types, 437 mio tokens). While RecipeNLG is more domain-specific, its vocabulary contains almost three times as many word types as Tiny Stories but only half as many tokens. For a language model, Tiny Stories, with its much lower type-token ratio, is easier to learn.
blocks.zh:
由于即使高度域特异性公司(corpora)通常也保留一些词典上的模糊性(如烹饪中的尺度仍然有与测量和鱼皮相关的读数),因此我们无法完全消除同质性,而是通过限制域来减少它.
我们解决了两个符合两个附加标准的公司问题:在其未经修改的状态下,同名体和单体之间的区别通过语义邻里距离(参见Tab. 1)可以明显地衡量,两者都使用共同的日常语言而不是专门的词汇,这支持我们的结论的概括性. 两个蝎子是(1) RecipeNLG Bień et al. (2020年),包含烹饪食谱(1.9 mio文件,63k字类型,195mio标志),以及(2) TinyStories Eldan和Li (2023年),包含简单语言(2.1 mio文件,24k字类型,437mio标志)的LLM生成的儿童故事. 虽然RecipeNLG更具有域特异性,但其词汇包含的字型几乎是Tiny Stories的三倍,但只包含一半的符号. 对于一种语言模型来说,小故事(Tiny Stories)的型号比要低得多,更容易学习.

blocks.en: 3.3 Modifying Corpora with Pseudowords
blocks.zh: 3.3 用修饰词修改 Corpora

blocks.en:
We modify each corpus with pseudowords that constitute either pseudo-homonyms or pseudo-hypernyms. Each corpus is modified with its own set of pseudowords, whose components are word pairs drawn from the respective corpus. The key variable underlying both types of pseudowords is the cosine distance between the components’ embeddings: pseudo-homonyms are constructed from maximally dissimilar pairs, while pseudo-hypernyms are constructed from maximally similar ones (which are additionally filtered by taxonomic relatedness). This allows us to study whether the effects we observe depend on the semantic distance between the words that a pseudoword replaces. We proceed as follows: First, we compute the cosine distance for all word pairs in each corpus. We retain only pairs whose components each occur in at least 300 documents and whose frequencies differ by at most a factor of 10. We further require that each word appears as a component in at most one pseudoword, so that the resulting sets are non-overlapping.
For pseudo- homonyms , we select the 50 most dissimilar non-overlapping word pairs, representing words with semantically divergent readings (e.g., structure and marmelade ).
For pseudo- hypernyms , we select the most similar non-overlapping word pairs and manually filter them for pairs that share a common category, i.e., pairs whose components could plausibly share a common ancestor in a taxonomy such as WordNet (e.g., mango and papaya are both fruit). This yields a list of 50 pseudo-hypernyms per corpus.
From each pair, we construct a pseudoword and manually create a name that is not part of the existing vocabulary, but remains reasonably similar to both components (e.g., marmelade and structure become structalade ). We verify that no pseudoword name occurs anywhere in the corpus, even as an incidental string.
blocks.zh:
我们用假词修改每个体,这些假词要么是伪同义词,要么是伪同义词。 每本书都用自己的一套假字进行修改,其组成部分是从各自的书目中抽取的词对. 这两种假名背后的关键变量是组件嵌入体之间的余弦距离:伪同义词由最大分异的对组成,而伪同义词则由最大相似的对组成(它们又被分类学相关性过滤). 这使得我们可以研究我们观察到的效果是否取决于一个伪词所取代的词之间的语义距离. 我们的工作如下: 首先,我们计算每个体中所有词组的余弦距离。 我们只保留了每一部分至少有300份文件的成份的对子,其频率最多为10倍。 我们进一步要求每个词最多在一个伪词中作为一个组成部分出现,这样所产生的各组词就不会重叠。
对于伪-同义词,我们选择50个最不相似的不重叠的词对,代表着有不同读数的词(例如结构与马列).
对于伪超名,我们选择最相似的不重叠的单词对,并手动过滤这些单词对,这些单词对具有一个共同的类别,即其组件可以合理地在WordNet(如芒果和木瓜都是水果)的分类学中共享一个共同的祖先的对子. 由此得出每例50个伪伪汉字列表.
从每对中,我们构建一个伪词,并手动创建一个不属于现有词汇的一部分的名称,但与两个组件保持合理相似(例如,marmelade和结构成为structalade ). 我们核实,任何假名 发生在任何在官司, 即使作为一个偶然串。

blocks.zh: 3.4 语义空间的修辞

blocks.en:
To verify that our pseudowords behave as expected, we compute the neighborhood distance for our pseudowords and compare them with standard monosemes, polysemes, and homonyms. For this, we use the list of homonyms, monosemes, and polysemes that Beekhuizen et al. (2021) derived from the WordSmyth dictionary. To distinguish the three word types, Beekhuizen et al. measure the average pairwise cosine distance between a word and its nearest neighbors in a Word2Vec space Mikolov et al. (2013) . The core idea is that monosemes should have tight neighbor clusters with low average distance, while more ambiguous words will show higher average distances, because their readings have close neighbors in multiple regions of the semantic space. In their experiments, homonyms show the largest distances, which we can confirm in our corpora.
Table 1 shows the average neighborhood distances using the 20 nearest neighbors for these word classes, and compares them with our pseudo-homonyms (HOM*) and pseudo-hypernyms (HYP*). As expected, our pseudo-homonyms show a neighborhood distance even larger than that of standard homonyms. The pseudo-hypernyms show a neighborhood distance comparable to that of natural homonyms in the recipe dataset: in Tiny Stories, it is closer to that of monosemes. This likely reflects the richer and more specialized vocabulary of the cooking domain, where co-hyponyms such as fridge and oven take on highly distinct functional roles and thus diverge more in semantic space than they would in a more general context.
blocks.zh:
为了证实我们的假字行为符合预期, 我们计算出我们伪字的邻里距离, 并将其与标准的单词,多词, 和同义词进行比较。 为此,我们使用Beekhuizen等人列出的同族体、单体和多体体。 (2021)来源于WordSmyth词典. 为区别三种词种,Beekhuizen等人著. 在Word2Vec空间中,测量一个单词与它最近的邻居之间的平均对偶余弦距离(2013年)。 核心思想是,单体应该有比较紧的邻星团,平均距离较低,而比较模糊的词会显示较高的平均距离,因为他们的读数在语义空间的多个区域有近邻. 在他们的实验中,同族体显示的距离最大,我们可以在我们的蝎子体内确认.
表1列出这些单词类使用20个近邻的平均邻里距离,并将其与我们的伪同名词(HOM*)和伪同名词(HYP*)进行比较. 如所料,我们的伪同义词显示的邻里距离甚至比标准的同义词还要大. 假韵母显示的邻里距离可以与食谱数据集中的自然同音相仿:在"小故事"(Tiny Stories)中,它更接近于单体. 这可能反映了烹饪领域更为丰富和专业化的词汇,其中冰箱和烤箱等共同韵律扮演了高度不同的功能角色,因此在语义空间上的差异比在更一般的情况下要大。

blocks.en: 3.5 Corpus Variants for Ablations
blocks.zh: 3.5 损坏的公司代用品

blocks.en:
We create multiple variants of our base datasets by replacing the component word pairs with pseudowords. We vary (1) the number of pseudoword types included (1, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50), (2) the type of pseudowords (pseudo-homonyms, "HOM" vs. pseudo-hypernyms, "HYP"), (3) whether we replace all occurrences of both components or only 50% (HALF, with half the occurrences of each component being replaced), and (4) the base dataset. The HALF-condition creates a scenario closer to natural ambiguity and underspecification: in standard texts, many homonyms coexist with synonyms (e.g., bat and club ), and hypernyms are used alongside their hyponyms. By including this condition, we can disentangle the effects of ambiguity and abstraction per se from the additional complexity introduced by the continued presence of the original component words. Overall, this yields 48 modified corpus variants and the two unmodified base corpora, for a total of 50 datasets, each serving as a training corpus for an individual language model.
We show all pseudowords and their components along with word frequencies and cosine similarity in Appendix A .
blocks.zh:
我们通过用假字取代组件单词对来创建我们的基础数据集的多个变体. 我们各不相同 (1)假字类型包括(1,10,20,30,40,50),(2)假字类型(pseudo-homonyms,"HOM" vs. p伪-hypernyms,"HYP"),(3)我们是否替换了两个元件的所有出现,还是仅50%(HALF,每个元件的出现一半被替换),(4)基础数据集. HALF-条件创造了一种更接近于自然模糊和描述不足的情景:在标准文本中,许多同义词与同义词(如蝙蝠和俱乐部)并存,超义词与它们的同义词并存. 通过列入这个条件,我们可以将模糊和抽象本身的影响与原组成词的继续存在所带来的额外复杂性分开. 总体而言,这产生了48个修改体变体和两个未修改基体,总共50个数据集,每个数据集都充当一个个别语言模型的培训机构。

blocks.zh: 4 试验和评价

blocks.en: 4.1 Models and Parameters
blocks.zh: 4.1 模型和参数

blocks.en:
For each of the 50 corpus variants (including the two unmodified base corpora), we train a GPT-2 model from scratch 2 2 2 n_layers=6, n_head=6, n_embed=384, dropout=0.2, learning_rate=0.001, batch_size=64, block_size=256, grad_clip=1.0 . We emphasize that these are not fine-tuned from a pretrained checkpoint but trained from scratch on our corpora alone, so that any effect we observe can be attributed to the training data. For tokenization, we use the standard pre-trained GPT-2 BPE tokenizer across all models. Hyperparameters are kept identical across all models to avoid confounds. We train three runs per model configuration to account for variance. Using one NVIDIA A6000 GPU, each training run took between 25 and 40 minutes, for a total of approximately 75 GPU hours.
We evaluate each model by measuring next-token prediction accuracy on a held-out validation set. Each corpus variant has its own training, validation, and test split
(80%/15%5%), with the pseudoword modifications applied throughout. We first train and evaluate the baseline models on the unmodified corpora, then train individual models for each experimental condition and compare their next-token prediction accuracy. Significance is tested with a one-tailed t-test, averaging over the three runs per configuration; when aggregating conditions, we average over all runs within the group.

blocks.en: 4.2 Increasing Ambiguity and Underspecification
blocks.zh: 4.2 含糊不清和规格不足

blocks.en: In our first set of experiments, we successively introduce pseudo-homonyms and pseudo-hypernyms into each dataset, replacing all occurrences of the component words. We increase the number of pseudoword types starting with 1, then from 10 to 50 in increments of 10. This simulates increased ambiguity and underspecification in the models’ language and allows us to compare the two. Apart from the first word (where we use the most similar component word pair for HYP and the most dissimilar one for HOM), the average cosine distance of the pseudoword components is constant across all models.
blocks.zh: 在我们的第一套实验中,我们相继将伪同义词和伪同义词引入到每个数据集中,取代了组件词的所有出现. 从1开始,我们增加假字型的数量,然后从10种增量增加到50种,即10种。 这模拟了模型语言中更加模糊和不够具体,使我们能够比较两者。 除了第一个单词(我们使用HYP最相似的元件单词对和HOM最不相似的单词对)外,假名元件的平均余弦距离在所有模型中都是不变的.

blocks.en:
Figure 1 shows the results for all runs, averaged over both corpora (cf. App. B for individual corpus results).
The introduction of greater ambiguity and underspecification improves performance if the new words replace both components (i.e., there is only "papango" left in the corpus, and both "mango" and "papaya" are replaced in all occurrences). If we retain the components (equivalent to synonyms for the pseudo-homonyms and hyponyms for the pseudo-hypernyms), there are no significant performance changes.
blocks.zh:
图1显示所有调查的结果,平均为两个公司的结果(个人调查的结果,参见App.B)。
如果新词取代两个元件(即本体中仅存"papango",而"mango"和"papaya"在所有情况下均被替换),引入更大的模糊度和不够具体化会提高性能. 如果我们保留这些组件(相当于伪名词的同义词和伪名词的同义词),则没有显著的性能变化.

blocks.en: Changing the level of ambiguity or underspecification also changes the type-token ratio (TTR) of the underlying corpus (more pseudoword types → \rightarrow smaller TTR). According to the optimality theory of language, this vocabulary compression licenses ambiguity as a means of efficiency. To test whether this also predicts model performance, we compute TTR based on the corpus tokenized with the BPE-tokenizer used to train the models, defined as the ratio of unique types to the total number of tokens. We then train a linear regression model to predict the increase in LM accuracy from the reduction in TTR. Fig. 2 shows the results.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Linear regression predicting changes in LM accuracy from TTR for all models; regression coefficient for TTR change is 0.86.
blocks.zh: 图 2:线性回归预测所有模型的LM精度变化;TTR变化的回归系数为0.86.

blocks.en: We find that we can almost perfectly predict the change in accuracy from the change in TTR, which also explains the differences between HOM and HYP. Across all models and conditions, the regression coefficient is 0.86; excluding the HALF models (which show no significant change in accuracy), the coefficient is even higher at 0.96.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,我们几乎可以完全预测TTR的变化所产生的精度变化,这也解释了HOM和HYP之间的差异. 在所有模型和条件中,回归系数为0.86;不包括HALF模型(其准确性没有显著变化),系数在0.96时甚至更高.

blocks.en: Note that the change in TTR is driven not only by the reduction in token types but also by an increase in the absolute number of tokens (cf. App. B ), because the pseudowords are all tokenized by the BPE tokenizer. Our setup thus does not gain resource efficiency for generation, just a more compact vocabulary. Exploring whether using in-vocabulary words rather than pseudowords could provide a valid mechanism for model compression is a subject for future work.
blocks.zh: 注意TTR的改变不仅是由符号类型的减少所推动的,也是由符号的绝对数的增加所推动的(参见App. B),因为假字都是由BPE的符号来表示. 因此,我们的设置并没有获得发电的资源效率,只是一个更为紧凑的词汇。 探索使用vocabulary单词而不是伪词能否为模型压缩提供有效机制,是未来工作的主题.

blocks.en: Takeaways: We see linguistic optimality theory reflected in overall model performance: By compressing the language using homonyms and hypernyms, models become more effective. Neither ambiguity nor abstraction adds complexity that outweighs the gains from a smaller type-token ratio.
blocks.zh: 外卖:我们看到语言优化理论在整体模型性能中有所体现: 通过使用同义词和超义词压缩语言,模型变得更加有效. 模糊性或抽象性均不增加复杂性,其程度大于较小的类型吻合比率的收益。

blocks.en: 4.3 Pseudowords and Their Components
blocks.zh: 4.3 修辞及其组成部分

blocks.en:
While the previous experiment showed that the presence of synonyms and hyponyms (in the HALF models) makes the language harder for the model to learn, overall performance did not decrease. We want to explore the results in more detail, assessing how well the pseudowords and their synonyms (or hyponyms) can be generated. For this, we separate the validation batches into three groups: (1) batches containing at least one pseudoword, (2) batches containing at least one pseudoword component but no pseudoword (for the HALF models only), and (3) batches containing neither. This lets us assess whether the model can reliably generate pseudowords, whether accuracy on surrounding tokens is affected, and whether component words become harder to generate when competing with a pseudo-homonym or pseudo-hypernym. Note that we do not directly compare the accuracy of producing pseudowords or their components, since single-word accuracy is difficult to match with adequate controls. Instead, we use the accuracy on batches containing the target words as a proxy for the model’s ability to generate them.
Figure 3 shows the results. We report the difference in accuracy between pseudoword batches or component batches (HALF models only) with batches containing no pseudowords or components ("neither"). Batches containing pseudo-homonyms or their components show significantly lower accuracy than batches without them. Pseudo-hypernyms, by contrast, perform better on both pseudoword batches and component batches, with significant increases for pseudo-hypernyms in the full replacement strategy. In all cases, the presence of synonyms or hyponyms of the pseudowords lowers performance, with the component words performing even worse than the pseudowords themselves. This mechanism could, at a larger scale, contribute to bias — for instance, introducing a general term like president could make more specific terms like chairman or chairwoman harder to learn.
blocks.zh:
虽然之前的实验表明同义词和低名词的存在(HALF模型中)使得模型学习语言更加困难,但整体性能并没有下降. 我们要更详细地探索结果,评估伪名词及其同义词(或低名词)的生成情况。 为此,我们把验证批次分为三组:(1)至少包含一个伪词的批次,(2)至少包含一个伪词成分但没有伪词的批次(仅针对HALF型号),(3)不包含两个伪词的批次. 这让我们来评估该模型是否能够可靠地生成伪词,周边符号上的准确性是否受到影响,以及与伪同义词或伪同义词竞争时,组件词是否变得更难生成. 请注意,我们并不直接比较生产伪字或其组件的准确性,因为单字精度难以与适当的控制相匹配. 相反,我们使用包含目标词的批次的精确度来代替模型生成它们的能力。
图3显示了结果。 我们报告伪字批次或组件批次(仅HALF型号)在准确度上的区别,批次中不含伪字或组件("两个也不"). 含有伪同义词的电池或其组件的精度明显低于没有这种精度的批次。 相比之下,Pseudo-hypernyms在伪字批次和组件批次上表现较好,在全置换策略中伪Hypernyms有显著的增加. 在所有情况下,假名词的同义词或副名词的存在都会降低性能,而成分词的表现甚至比假名词本身还要差. 这一机制在更大范围内会助长偏见——例如,引入一个主席可以使主席或主席等更具体的条款更难学习的一般术语。

blocks.en: 4.4 Findings on localization
blocks.zh: 4.4 关于本地化的结论

blocks.en:
In addition to measuring model performance, we analyzed model parameters to provide a mechanistic account of ambiguity and underspecification. We examine whether any geometric measures vary linearly with the number of pseudowords. We mainly focused on Von Neumann Entropy (VNE), which is the Shannon Entropy of a matrix’s eigenvalues. We hypothesized that greater ambiguity or underspecification would increase entropy, showing higher uncertainty in the model. We indeed found that the effective rank of the first weight matrix (usually denoted W 1 W_{1} ) in the Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) increases linearly with the number of pseudowords (details in App. C ). This increase is independent of type-token ratio: It happens in the HALF-models and in all HOM and HYP models. Recent studies have identified MLP layers as effective predictors of diverse semantic relations Xue and Andrzejak (2026) . However, we find significant effects only for RecipeNLG, not for Tiny Stories (where changes in TTR and performance were also much smaller than for RecipeNLG). While we consider this a preliminary finding, the localization in the mid-layers aligns well with previous work and our own insights into disambiguation (cf. Sec. 4.5 ): Most of the changes in VNE were observable in the middle layers, where we also observe disambiguation.
We found no difference in the input embeddings, neither in VNE nor in the spread of the vector space used. While other measures might reveal more fine-grained differences here, we assume that the parameters change only where actual disambiguation occurs.

blocks.en: 4.5 Disambiguation and Specification

blocks.en:
With probing experiments, we want to learn whether the internal processing of ambiguity differs from that of underspecification, and whether we can locate the disambiguation and sense specification within the model activations.
We probe the four *50-HALF models using the pseudowords and their component words for disambiguation or specification. For this, we use lexical patterns with either ambiguous or disambiguated sentences. We measure whether the model-internal activations change when we add the component word that disambiguates the sense (a synonym) or specifies it (a hyponym). E.g., a neutral pattern is This is another [structalade], like the other one. (inserting the pseudoword), and the corresponding disambiguated pattern would be This is another [structalade], like the other [marmelade]. (inserting both pseudoword and one of the component words). As a reference for component-word activation, we use the neutral pattern and insert the component word in place of the pseudoword (e.g., This is another [marmelade], like the other one ).

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Our study has shown how increasing ambiguity or underspecification changes the behavior of language models trained on this data, and how these two phenomena differ. We evaluated changes in LM performance by using pseudo-homonyms or pseudo-hypernyms. We showed that increasing either ambiguity or underspecification improves overall model performance, a pattern that can be directly predicted from the decrease in the type-token ratio. In that respect, ambiguity and underspecification have similar effects in language models compared to those predicted for human language processing. However, we find that in settings where synonyms or individual hyponyms still occur in the training corpus, both the pseudowords and their component words are generated less reliably than other vocabulary. We also provided a preliminary mechanistic account of ambiguity, underspecification, and disambiguation: more ambiguous or underspecified language increases Von-Neumann Entropy in the model’s MLP layer parameters. Further, activation-based disambiguation analysis shows that the readings of pseudo-homonyms are resolved, but underspecification for pseudo-hypernyms is retained.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究显示,越来越模糊或不够具体化,如何改变在这些数据上受过训练的语言模型的行为,以及这两种现象有何不同。 我们通过使用伪同义词或伪同义词来评价LM性能的变化. 我们显示,增加模糊性或不够具体化可改善总体模型性能,这种模式可以从类型比的下降直接预测。 在这方面,与预测用于人类语言处理的语言模型相比,语言模型的含混度和具体性不足具有类似的效果。 然而,我们发现,在培训大纲中仍然出现同义词或个别低名词的场合,伪词及其组成词的生成可靠性低于其他词汇. 我们还提供了一种关于模糊性,不精确性,和分化性的初步机械化描述:在模型的MLP层参数中,语言更模糊或分化不足会增加Von-Neumann Entropy. 此外,基于激活的混淆分析显示,伪同义词的读数已经解决,但保留了伪同义词的不完全规格.

blocks.en: We observed significant effects with concrete implications for responsible LLM design. On the one hand, model vocabulary can be compressed by reducing vocabulary diversity through abstraction, leading to higher overall performance. On the other hand, ambiguity can harm performance for both the underspecified expressions and their hyponyms or individual readings.
blocks.zh: 我们看到对负责任的LLM设计具有具体影响的重大影响。 一方面,模型词汇可以通过抽象来减少词汇的多样性来压缩,从而导致更高的整体性能. 另一方面,模棱两可既会损害未指定表达式的性能,也会损害其副名或个别读物的性能.

blocks.en: In future work, we aim to explore the effects of ambiguity on a larger scale, and provide more measures for localizing ambiguity within the model. Further, we aim to dig deeper into the processes of resolving ambiguity and underspecification, giving a more precise account of when a resolution happens and when it does not. Those studies can then help to anchor bias research in mechanistic interpretability for fairer and more reliable LLMs.
blocks.zh: 在今后的工作中,我们的目标是探讨较大规模地模糊性的影响,并提供更多的措施,使模型中的模糊性本地化。 此外,我们力求更深入地探讨解决含糊不清和不够具体的问题,更准确地说明何时通过决议,何时通过决议。 然后,这些研究可以帮助将偏见研究植根于机械解释性,以便更公平和更可靠的法学硕士课程。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our experiments comprise many individual language models based on several modifications of two base corpora. While this provides an in-depth analysis, the scope is limited in several respects:
blocks.zh: 我们的实验包括许多基于两个基团的若干修改的个别语言模型. 虽然这提供了深入分析,但范围在几个方面是有限的:

blocks.en: All our models are GPT-2 models trained from scratch. While we believe that our results carry over to other model families, this remains to be verified. Further, to avoid confounders, we did not optimize hyperparameters individually for each run; some effects might change with hyperparameter tuning.
blocks.zh: 我们所有的模型都是从零开始训练的GPT-2模型. 虽然我们认为我们的成果会延续到其他模范家庭,但这仍有待核实。 此外,为了避免出现混乱,我们没有为每一次运行单独优化超参数;有些影响可能会随着超参数调制而改变。

blocks.en: With pseudohomonyms and pseudohypernyms, we study only one type of ambiguity and one type of abstraction. Both phenomena occur at multiple linguistic levels that interact with each other, and we have only examined a small subset that we could cover with pseudowords. Future work will need to present experimental setups that accommodate different types of ambiguity, such as syntactic or discourse-level ambiguity.
blocks.zh: 有了伪同义词和伪同义词,我们只研究一种模糊和一种抽象. 这两种现象都发生在多种语言层次上相互相互作用,我们只研究了一个小子集,我们可以用假词来覆盖. 今后的工作需要提出能够容纳不同类型的模糊性的实验性安排,如综合或语境层面的模糊性。

blocks.en: To isolate effects of small language changes, we used small language models and restricted corpora. Future work needs to scale our findings to larger models, different domain-specific corpora, and more general corpora. In those settings, established benchmarks (e.g., HellaSwag) can be used to test the impact of ambiguity; such benchmarks are not meaningful for our small models, so we rely on next-token prediction accuracy as our sole evaluation metric. Scaling up will also show whether our assumption holds that models compressed through pseudohypernyms still perform well on downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 为了隔离小语言变化的影响,我们使用了小语言模型和限制性的corpora. 未来的工作需要把我们的发现推广到更大的模型,不同的域特异性公司,以及更广泛的公司. 在这些环境下,可以使用既定的基准(如HelaSwag)来测试模糊性的影响;这些基准对我们的小型模型没有意义,因此我们依靠下接的预测准确性作为我们唯一的评价尺度. 放大还显示我们的假设是否认为,通过伪韵律压缩的模型在下游任务中仍然表现良好。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: Our research can contribute to more sustainable model development: we provide initial evidence that linguistically motivated compression of LLMs is feasible, showing that pseudohypernyms can reduce vocabulary variety and improve performance, especially for domain-specific models. If these findings scale, they could reduce the computational resources and energy required for model training. We also believe our results can inform research on fairness, since we show that the introduction of ambiguous or underspecified terms can degrade accuracy not only for those terms but also for their related words — a mechanism that, at scale, could contribute to bias propagation in ways that are difficult to detect by examining individual terms in isolation.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究可以促进更可持续的模型开发:我们提供了初步证据,证明语言动机压缩LLM是可行的,表明伪韵律可以减少词汇种类,提高性能,特别是针对特定域的模型. 如果这些结果达到规模,它们可以减少模型培训所需的计算资源和能量。 我们还认为,我们的成果可以为关于公平性的研究提供信息,因为我们表明,采用模棱两可的或不明确的术语不仅会降低这些术语的准确性,而且还会降低其相关词语的准确性,而这种机制在规模上可能以孤立地审查个别术语难以发现的方式助长偏见的传播。
